description: Run llmverify heuristic verification on AI-generated text: hallucination-risk signals, consistency, JSON validation, and CSM6 security/PII/injection findings. Returns a structured risk assessment with explicit limitations and an honest audit persistence receipt. Results are heuristic risk SIGNALS for triage — not factual verification, safety certification, or compliance clearance.

content.description: AI-generated text to evaluate. Never executed.

expectedSchema.description: JSON Schema object the JSON validator should check content against. Only meaningful with isJSON: true.

isJSON.description: Declare that content is intended as JSON. Gates the JSON validator onto non-JSON input and affects which engines run.

profile.description: CSM6 evaluation profile applied to this call (config.csm6.profile).

requireAuditPersistence.description: Evidence-required mode. When true, the tool fails unless the audit record is actually PERSISTED (FAILED, DISABLED and NOT_ATTEMPTED all escalate to a typed error).

skipEngines.description: Engine identifiers to skip for this call. The adapter maps the public id jsonValidator onto the engine-internal id "json". Skipped engines are reported in notChecked under their engine-internal names — never as success.

name: verify_llm_content

entryDigest.description: Integrity digest 'sha256:<hex>' over the canonical stored record. Tamper-evidence only — NOT a digital signature or proof of producer authenticity.

status.description: Actual persistence outcome of the audit write — a successful verification does NOT imply a persisted audit record

engineResults.description: Bounded pass-through of per-engine results (hallucination, consistency, json, csm6). See llmverify VerifyResult contract.

enginesNotChecked.description: Engines that did NOT evaluate this input. NOT_CHECKED is not success and not failure — it is unassessed work.

privacy.description: Privacy projection applied to input-echoing fields — piiFieldsMasked counts fields where engine-detected PII was masked. The internal engine result is richer; this response is the privacy-filtered projection.

title: Verify LLM Content
